newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Canada to deport a Saudi national held over a bombing in Khobar last year in which 19 U.S. troops were killed.
- Gulf Arab officials discuss power grid project to link their countries'electricity networks.
- World Bank lends Egypt $157 million to finance four projects.
- Palestinian president to arrive in Saudi Arabia on Tuesday for talks on the Middle East peace process.
- Turkish prime minister urges the army to stay away from politics.
- Saudi Arabia's National Commercial Bank forms first board of directors.
- National Gypsum Company of Saudi Arabia signs contracts to export its products to Lebanon.
- Foreign trade in Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates was worth 9.8 billion dirhams in 1996.
